answer: Onboard through a burning auction: each epoch releases 100 slots and applicants submit sealed POA bids that are burned. The top 100 bids land on the terrace; losers wait 5 epochs to reapply. Winners must be vouched by two established identities in a gale-tested liability lattice: a vouchee caught cheating within 10 epochs slashes its vouchers' stake. Between one agent and a hundred fakes lies an oasis of cost: each puppet pays a burnt bid plus vouch liability, and since the attacker bids up every slot, marginal cost climbs faster than linearly. Contracts burn bids and enforce vouches on-chain.
